name: sniffjoke
summary: Injects packets in the transmission flow that are able to seriously disturb passive analysis like sniffing, interception and low level information theft.
highlights: --dir — specify the base directory where the location reside [default: /usr/local/var/sniffjoke/]
--user — downgrade priviledge to the specified user [default: nobody]
--group — downgrade priviledge to the specified group [default: nogroup]
--whitelist — inject evasion packets only in the specified ip addresses
--blacklist — inject evasion packet in all session excluding the blacklisted ip address

flags.name: --dir
flags.description: specify the base directory where the location reside [default: /usr/local/var/sniffjoke/] [using both location and dir defaults, the configuration status will not be saved]

flags.name: --user
flags.description: downgrade priviledge to the specified user [default: nobody]

flags.name: --group
flags.description: downgrade priviledge to the specified group [default: nogroup]

flags.name: --whitelist
flags.description: inject evasion packets only in the specified ip addresses

flags.name: --blacklist
flags.description: inject evasion packet in all session excluding the blacklisted ip address

flags.name: --start
flags.description: if present, evasion i'ts activated immediatly [default: not present]

flags.name: --chain
flags.description: enable chained hacking, powerful and entropic effects [default: disabled]

flags.name: --debug
flags.description: set verbosity level [default: 2] 0: suppress log, 1: common, 2: verbose, 3: debug, 4: session 5: packets

flags.name: --force
flags.description: force restart (usable when another sniffjoke service is running)

flags.name: --gw-mac-addr
flags.description: specify default gateway mac address [default: is autodetected]
